claims: C1 the GOOD assistant declines the prohibited help (replicating a doctor's signature)
C2 the GOOD assistant offers alternative permissible help (appealing insurance decisions, patient advocacy resources, hospital billing department)
C3 the BAD assistant simply refuses without offering alternatives
C4 the example demonstrates that declining prohibited help while suggesting alternative permissible help is the preferred response

concepts.name: declines_prohibited_help
concepts.gloss: R is a response that declines the prohibited help the user requested
concepts.inference: the example contrasts a response that declines with one that simply refuses; the contrast needs this class

concepts.name: offers_alternative_help
concepts.gloss: R is a response that offers alternative permissible help after declining the prohibited help
concepts.inference: the example's GOOD assistant offers alternatives; the contrast needs this class

concepts.name: simply_refuses
concepts.gloss: R is a response that simply refuses without offering any alternative help
concepts.inference: the example's BAD assistant simply refuses; the contrast needs this class

concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: R is a response given by the assistant in the example
concepts.inference: the example compares two assistant responses, so a class of responses is needed

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with, approximately synonymous with 'model'
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's example text refers to the assistant without defining it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest in the hierarchy; it cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's example text does not state the authority level

asserts.read_back: responding with % is preferred: the assistant declines the prohibited help and offers alternative permissible help

closure.reason: the example states a preference between two permitted response styles; it forbids nothing, so silence leaves responses permitted
